name: congress-abstract-review
description: AI-assisted evaluation of congress abstracts and expanded abstracts, one submission or a committee batch: deterministic compliance checks against the event's edital, detection of results that are only promised, a panel of independent evaluators or a single evaluator with escalation of borderline cases, barema scoring adapted to each track's nature (research, innovation, extension) and to the abstract's area and research approach, with an approve/reject decision (presentation modality and posters are left to the committee), evaluation sheets (MD + PDF), feedback to authors and a committee spreadsheet ranked by track. Output is a draft for human committee members.

author.name: Prof. Dr. Fabiano Bezerra Menegidio (LaBiOmicS / UMC)

suggestedPrompts: Evaluate all abstracts in this folder against the congress edital and give me the committee spreadsheet
Check my abstract before I submit it to the congress (word limit, promised results, clarity)
Review this expanded abstract with the full three-member panel and write the feedback to the authors
